services.title: Comfort-Focused Dental Care
services.description: Designed specifically for anxious patients, sensitive gums, or low pain tolerance. Gentle techniques and topical pre-numbing for a relaxed visit.
keyBenefits: Fast recovery - walk out feeling comfortable
services.idealFor: Dental anxiety, sensitive gums, routine & surgical care

services.title: Impacted Wisdom Tooth Surgery
services.description: Atraumatic surgical extraction of deeply angled or impacted wisdom molars with minimal bone disturbance to ensure swift healing.
keyBenefits: Protects adjacent second molar roots & nerves
services.idealFor: Pericoronitis, jaw pain, crowded molars, hidden decay

services.title: BPS Precision & Flexible Dentures
services.description: Custom precision prosthetic system delivering reliable suction, natural facial support, and authentic lip fullness for complete chewing comfort.
keyBenefits: Zero adhesive required for daily speech and chewing
services.idealFor: Complete or partial tooth loss, unstable existing dentures

services.title: Fixed Partial Dentures (FPD) & Zirconia Crowns
services.description: Permanent non-removable dental bridges and monolithic zirconia crowns that seamlessly bridge gaps and restore maximum chewing stability.
keyBenefits: Digital shade matching to natural enamel gradient
Precision margin sealing against secondary caries
services.idealFor: Missing teeth, fractured crowns, post-RCT protection

services.title: Porcelain Veneers & Smile Makeovers
services.description: Ultra-thin custom porcelain ceramic laminates crafted to correct spacing, discolorations, chips, and irregular tooth alignment.
keyBenefits: Customized smile harmony suited to your facial profile
services.idealFor: Gap closure, fluorosis stains, chipped teeth, uneven edges

services.title: Rotary Single-Sitting Root Canal (RCT)
services.description: Electronic apex locator guided root canal therapy designed to relieve severe toothaches in a single relaxed sitting while preserving your original tooth.
keyBenefits: Immediate pain relief from infected pulp
services.idealFor: Deep cavities, sudden throbbing pain, hot/cold sensitivity
